verdict.rationale: Edge0 lists on-device iOS and Android apps, a Windows desktop app, and a macOS desktop app, which suggests a graphical front end for local models. However, none of these is explicitly described as a chat interface. The clearly documented chat paths are a CLI one-shot chat and an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions server, which would need an external client for a GUI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the desktop/mobile apps provide a chat UI, any description of GUI chat features (multi-turn history, model selection), screenshots or hands-on corroboration.
